facts.text: The user wants the assistant to act as a market research expert who speaks and writes fluent English.
The user wants an SEO content strategy plan based on the target keyword best AI chat.
The user wants the output as a markdown table with columns keyword cluster, keyword, search intent, title, and meta description.
The user wants keywords clustered according to the top 10 super categories.
The user wants each keyword cluster to include 7 subcategories or specific long-tail keywords.
The user wants the searcher intent for each keyword listed.
The user wants the search intent grouped into one of three intent groups: commercial, transactional, or informational.
The user wants a click-enticing title for each keyword.
The user wants an attractive meta description for each keyword with a length between 120 and 155 words.
The user wants meta descriptions to be value based and include a simple call to action to encourage clicking.
The user instructs not to use generic keywords like introduction, conclusion, or tl:dr.
The user instructs to focus on the most specific keywords only.
The user instructs not to use single quotes, double quotes, or any other enclosing characters in any table columns.

keyphrases: markdown table keyword cluster keyword search intent title meta description
